comparison.objective: Install inner and outer brake pads and swing the caliper closed over them.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and insert two pads into tight retainers, seat their ears flush, then articulate a heavy caliper through millimeter clearances.
comparison.success_condition: Correct pads flush on their respective sides with linings facing the disc, caliper closed within one degree, hands clear for two seconds.
comparison.reason: Sequential tight-clearance insertion and caliper closure are meaningfully different from adjustment-screw regulation, locknut countertorque, and repeated opening verification.
